summary: NaaS Technology Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, Beijing-based EV-charging services company, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, signed by CFO Steven Sim on November 5, 2026. No transaction, shareholder action, or corporate event is disclosed. Figures show first-half 2026 revenue of RMB 45.5 million versus RMB 66.6 million a year earlier, gross profit of RMB 38.7 million, and an accumulated deficit of roughly RMB 8.67 billion; total equity remains negative at about RMB 890 million. This is a routine periodic-reporting filing, not a special situation; no deal terms, premium, or advisor appears. Watch for liquidity and going-concern disclosures given current borrowings of RMB 519 million against cash of RMB 77 million.
